items.t: Valve seat drops out and damages the engine
items.job: Replace cylinder head or install a used engine
items.note: Owners report about $2,100 on average. On an older Escort a used engine is often cheaper than fixing the head.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit

items.t: Shifting problems or won't go into gear
items.job: Diagnose and repair or replace automatic transmission
items.note: A shift solenoid is the low end; owners report $1,500 to $2,400 for full repairs.

items.t: Engine runs rough or misfires
items.job: Replace spark plugs, wires and ignition coil
items.note: RepairPal estimates ignition coil replacement at about $169-$245.

items.t: Rough idle (ZX2)
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve

items.t: Engine knocking at high mileage
items.job: Replace engine with a used unit

items.t: Whistling or noise from the PCV valve
items.job: Replace PCV valve and hose

items.t: Engine stutters or struggles when starting
items.job: Diagnose and replace failed ignition or fuel part

items.t: Timing belt breaks and engine quits
items.job: Replace timing belt and tensioner
items.note: Owners report about $700. If valves were damaged, the cost rises sharply.

items.t: Check engine light on
items.job: Read codes and replace failed emissions sensor

items.t: Automatic seat belts get stuck
items.job: Repair or replace motorized seat belt track and motor

items.t: Battery won't hold a charge
items.job: Replace battery

items.t: Air bag light on from contaminated monitor (recall)
items.job: Replace air bag monitor

items.t: Replacement seat belts may not lock (recall)
items.job: Replace affected seat belt assembly

items.t: Seat belt buckles may not latch fully (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt buckles

items.t: Shift indicator may not show the right gear (recall)
items.job: Correct shift lever indicator

items.t: Brakes fail or the pedal goes soft
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: A leaking brake line is a similar cost.

items.t: Front rotors wear out before the pads
items.job: Replace front brake rotors and pads

items.t: Transmission differential fails
items.job: Replace transaxle with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Owners report about $4,000 at a dealer.

items.t: Alternator burns out
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Car stops moving in Reverse
items.job: Diagnose and repair transmission reverse clutch

items.t: Rear end sways over bumps
items.job: Replace rear struts (pair)

items.t: Control relay module failure stops A/C or fan
items.job: Replace constant control relay module
